note: these are USGS gauges with a 2023 daily record on the four rivers, and they are headwater or conduit gauges: of 137 gauges named for the Kings, Kaweah, Tule and Kern, 22 have any 2023 daily discharge and none is a main-stem or below-dam gauge. The Kings main stem at Piedra ended in 1959, the Kaweah at McKay Point in 1921, the Tule below Success in 1990. The flow that reached the lake bed passed through Corps reservoirs recorded by the Corps and California DWR, not here, so each gauge carries the fraction of its river's basin it represents and the inflow itself is not in this panel
